description_en: Adds one or more Access Control List (ACL) rules to an endpoint of a specified type
description_zh: 本接口用于新增指定类型的接入点的一条或多条Acl规则
kebab_example: aliyun mns-open authorize-endpoint-acl --biz-endpoint-type public --acl-strategy allow --cidr-list 192.168.1.1/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AuthorizeEndpointAcl

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid value:

public: An internet endpoint. Only public is supported
parameters.help_zh:
接入点类型。取值：

public：表示公网接入点。(目前仅支持public)
parameters.name: endpoint_type

parameters.help_en:
The access control list (ACL) policy. Valid value:

allow: A CIDR whitelist. Only allow is supported
parameters.help_zh:
Acl策略。取值：

allow：表示此次操作的为Cidr白名单。(目前仅支持allow)
parameters.name: acl_strategy
